HYPOTHESIS: 16_11463_6 is the key circuit hub. It integrates the bonucleic embedding (strongest input, w=24.7) with residual stream info from L7-L15 and sends a strong signal downstream through L19, L22, and directly to the output logit. The negative weights from bos and DNA embeddings suggest it is specifically suppressing non-chemistry contexts.

The hub is fed by bonucleic (w=24.7), MLP residuals from L7-L15, and also receives cross-position signal from deoxy embedding (E_231035_4, w=2.4) and stands embedding (E_12353_2, w=2.7). EARLY LAYER: 0_9026_6 is a key layer-0 transcoder feature (out_degree=230). Reads all 7 embeddings with bonucleic dominant (+22.2). Sends mostly NEGATIVE weights downstream to L22-L25 features. This appears to be a broad bonucleic-context detector that acts as a suppressor/gate for late-layer features.

CASCADE STRUCTURE: The circuit has a clear cascading backbone at position 6: E_230710_6 → 16_11463_6 (L16) → 19_4063_6 (L19) → 21_12675_6 (L21) / 22_9740_6 (L22) → 23_6638_6 (L23) → output. Each node feeds into the next AND directly to output. This is confirmed by in-degree ranking: 16_11463_6 has 825 incoming edges (highest non-output), followed by 19_4063_6 (770), 22_9740_6 (696), 21_12675_6 (693), 23_6638_6 (610).

(3) E_12353_2 (stands, pos2) → 16_11463_6 (w=2.7). The circuit is overwhelmingly dominated by position 6 (bonucleic) processing.

CORE BACKBONE: E_230710_6 (bonucleic) -> 16_11463_6 (L16 hub, w=24.7) -> 19_4063_6 (L19, w=24.4) -> 21_12675_6 (L21) / 22_9740_6 (L22) -> 23_6638_6 (L23) -> output. Each backbone node also connects directly to output.
